pages.text: $(italic)Swift, graceful, and hungry. Elves are the best mobile fighters but require more food management.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$() — Permanent night vision in dim environments. No UI effect — seamlessly dark to light.$(br2)$(bold)Swift$() — +10% movement speed permanently. Combines very well with Ranger, Samurai, Archmage.$(br2)$(bold)Fragile$() — -8% armor effectiveness from all worn armor. The tradeoff for speed.$(br2)$(bold)Hunger Penalty$() — +20% food drain rate. Fast metabolism is the cost of being an Elf.
